title: There's always a upper level
content: And it's always uninhabitable. Like, the floor isn't sturdy enough or something. But I'll be up there anyways, aware that I'm on the third level, even though I usually stay on the second. I always get feelings of like, almost a yearning to live in the space, and feel sad that I cant because the floors just arnt sturdy enough. The actual place seems to kinda change every time I dream of it. But it's the same 'place' everytime, if that makes sense. The same third floor, the same feelings. The same level of decay. But sometimes it feels like my best friend's house from when I was 9 years old. Sometimes it's my grandma's old house. Sometimes it's my current house. These dreams always seem to happen at the end of a night of mall world dreams. Like I end up there after. They are definitely the ones closest to when I'm awake. Anyone else have similar experiences?
